title: SOPBench SOP — email intent
text:
Retail seller support email routing SOP.

1. Read the inbound seller email and classify the primary intent: order issue, listing quality, account access, payment/payout, policy dispute, or general enquiry.
2. If the email mixes intents, select the highest-severity intent that blocks fulfilment or payout.
3. For order issues, collect order ID, ASIN/SKU, and promised ship date before escalating.
4. For policy disputes, do not approve exceptions that violate safety or restricted-goods rules; escalate to compliance.
5. Log the chosen routing queue and acknowledgement template. Close only after a routing confirmation is recorded.

title: SOPBench SOP — customer service
text:
Customer service diagnostics SOP.

1. Authenticate the customer and locate the account and open cases.
2. Reproduce the reported symptom using system diagnostics for service area, subscription, and recent changes.
3. Apply the least-invasive fix first (reset, re-provision, schedule tech visit).
4. Document root cause category and final resolution status.
5. If diagnostics return conflicting signals, escalate with the full diagnostic transcript; do not invent device readings.

title: SOPBench SOP — warehouse package inspection
text:
Warehouse package inspection SOP.

1. Scan the inbound package barcode and verify it matches the expected consignment.
2. Inspect outer packaging for crush, tear, moisture, or seal tampering.
3. If damage is found, photograph evidence, quarantine the unit, and create a damage claim record before restocking.
4. For compliant packages, confirm weight/dimension band and place into putaway.
5. Never overwrite a failed inspection as passed without supervisor override and reason code.

title: SOPBench SOP — order fulfillment
text:
Order fulfilment workflow SOP.

1. Validate payment status and delivery address before reservation.
2. Reserve available inventory; if short, trigger partial-ship or cancel-and-notify per policy.
3. Pick, pack, and label using the wave instructions; verify SKU and quantity against the packing slip.
4. Hand off to carrier and publish tracking within the SLA window.
5. On exception (stockout after reserve, pick miss), open a fulfilment incident and notify the customer with the approved template.
